claim: As of 2 February 2026 Clair-based image scanning has been deprecated in Amazon ECR and all ECR accounts have been migrated to AWS native basic scanning.
question: What technology does ECR basic scanning use now, and when was Clair retired?

values.display: AWS native is now the only implementation of basic scanning

note: The new AWS native basic scanning became generally available on 2024-08-06 (FRESHNESS.md); that date is not in the saved ECR pages. Older questions mention Clair.
